articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.snippet: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
articles.snippet: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."
